data.name: Left 2 Fry
data.detailed_description:
Fight your way through endless waves of angry food in this fast-paced round-based survival shooter!

🍳 Round-Based Survival

Very simple rules - you fight through food mutated enemies, earn points, buy weapons off the walls, upgrade them, so objectives along the way and a bunch more stuff.

🍟 Food Weapons

These weapons are not your usual weapons.

Instead of your typical guns, you will be fighting with home-made food themed weapons. From Bacon-LMGs and Banana-Pistols, to Apple-Crossbows and Soda-Shotguns, every weapon has its own strengths and weaknesses. Find your favorites and upgrade them throughout your journey.

🔥 Grill-a-Gun & Mystery Freezer

As the rounds go on, enemies become tougher, so your weapons will have to keep up with everything else.

Upgrade at the Grill-a-Gun to unlock higher weapon tiers. Or, if you're feeling pretty lucky, punk, spend your Points at the Mystery Freezer for a random weapon.

🎯 Objectives & Special Rounds

Every match is a little different.

Complete objectives during a match to earn extra rewards, and survive special rounds that change the enemies you will be fighting. Some rounds are easier, some are much harder, so you will need to adapt as you go about fighting.

🌍 Explore

Each map contains unlock-able areas, useful machines, and totally different routes to explore. Learning the way of the maps is just as important as upgrading your weapons.

✍️ The Future

Left 2 Fry is still in very active development, and there is plenty of more content on the way. New weapons, upgrades, maps, enemies, progression systems, and more.

So if you would like to follow the game's development, consider wishlisting it. It really helps a solo developer like me.

[About Videos and Streaming]

Gameplay videos and livestreams are welcome. Please check the following two points:

  • Include "Left 2 Fry" in the title of your video or stream. (Required)

  • Include our Steam Store Page URL in the description. (Optional, but greatly appreciated!)

data.short_description: Serve up chaos! Left 2 Fry is a round-based survival shooter where the kitchen has gone rogue. Blast waves of sentient fast-food with an arsenal of wacky weapons. Earn points, unlock new areas, upgrade your gear and complete objectives. How long can you survive?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 630 / NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
